method: Validate a bounded base unit name, one-line description, supported service and restart types, an absolute executable path with up to 256 non-empty argument lines, optional absolute working directory, account name, dependency unit names, restart duration and install target. Quote each executable argument using systemd command-line rules, escaping backslashes, double quotes, dollar signs and percent specifiers. Omit restart directives for Type=oneshot and omit optional sections when their fields are blank. The tool generates text only and does not verify the target host or execute systemctl.
